item.title: Faster live workout replacement
item.summary: After you approve replacing one exact workout with exercises stated in chat, Murph can now create the complete replacement in one step.
item.details: The replacement binds approval to the exact workout version you saw, keeps the change atomic and retry-safe, preserves exact per-exercise repetition instructions, leaves other unfinished workouts untouched, and recognizes a recovered result only from the link added to the approved workout's tombstone.
